name: Commerce Layer API
tagline: Headless commerce API for multi-market catalogs, orders, prices, and tax/shipping rules.
description: Commerce Layer is a headless commerce platform API for multi-market catalogs, orders, prices, promotions, tax, and shipping. Developers integrate via REST (JSON:API) with OAuth2 client credentials for backend and sales channel tokens for storefronts.

auth.details: OAuth2 client credentials (application) for backend integrations; sales channel and integration tokens for storefronts. Bearer token in Authorization header. Self-serve signup via dashboard.

use_cases: list SKUs and products for a multi-market catalog
fetch market-specific prices and price lists
apply promotions and coupons to carts
calculate tax and shipping for an order
